faqs.q: How do I reset my password?
faqs.a: Open Sign In and tap Forgot Password. We send a reset link to your registered email address.

faqs.q: Where can I view my invoice?
faqs.a: Every completed order has an invoice in Order History. Open the order and tap the receipt to view or share it.
Our team is available 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM, seven days a week. Live chat replies usually arrive within a few minutes.

faqs.q: Why is voice ordering not recognising my items?
faqs.a: Check microphone permission, speak item names clearly and confirm your app language matches the language you speak.

faqs.q: Can I schedule an order for later?
faqs.a: Yes. At checkout choose Schedule Order, pick a date and time, and manage it any time from My Scheduled Orders.

faqs.q: How do I cancel or change an order?
faqs.a: Orders can be changed while they are still being prepared. Open the order from Order History and tap Cancel Order.
